context: Hiroshi visits the office for one last casual talk.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健次、ちょっと、寄ったんだ。
lines.en: Kenji — I stopped by for a moment.
lines.style: Measured opening, warm but composed. A senior visiting with quiet intention. Steady cadence, the ease of someone accustomed to being listened to. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長、嬉しい、来てくれて。
lines.style: Immediate warmth, the relief of someone genuinely moved. Sincere, not performative. Soft attack on the opening. Respectful but unguarded — the safety of a trusted relationship audible.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I wanted to see how the company is doing.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but beneath it: care. The cadence of someone checking in on what matters. Slight weight on 'wanted' — it wasn't a casual decision. Composed, steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 皆、お元気で、安心してる。
lines.en: Everyone's doing well — it puts my mind at ease.
lines.style: Relief threaded through gratitude. Soft, steady delivery. A moment of quiet pride in what he sees around him. Slight breath before continuing — taking it in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若い社員、立派、伸びてる。
lines.en: The young staff — they're doing excellent work, growing.
lines.style: Approval without weight. Observational, genuine. The tone of someone seeing potential and meaning it. Slight lift on 'excellent' — authentic encouragement, not flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長の指導、ずっと、繋がってる。
lines.en: Your guidance — it's stayed with all of us.
lines.style: Tender admiration. Slow, deliberate pacing. The weight of sincerity in each phrase. A quiet moment of recognition — this matters, and he's not hiding it. Breath before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人生、振り返ると、お前と、過ごせて、よかった。
lines.en: Looking back on my life, I'm grateful we've spent this time together.
lines.style: Deep, unhurried. The tone of someone reaching for words that matter. Soft opening, slight catch in 'grateful' — genuine emotion just below the surface. Weighted pause between phrases. Composure, but real.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Truly, I'm grateful — every single day.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Each word lands. Soft but not tentative. The intimacy of someone saying something he means completely. Slight tremor of emotion held steady. Trailing softly on 'day'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お前、会社、立派に、続けてる。
lines.en: You've carried on this company with real excellence.
lines.style: Affirmation with weight. Calm, steady delivery. The recognition of someone who doesn't give praise lightly. Slight emphasis on 'excellence' — earned, not easy. The satisfaction of seeing something continue well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来た、宝。
lines.en: Everything we built together — that's the true treasure.
lines.style: Soft, reverent. The pace slows. 'Together' carries the heart of the sentence. Not looking away from what this means. Breath before 'treasure' — the word has substance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: You're a truly precious person to me.
lines.style: Spare, profound. Three words that carry years. Quiet, without decoration. The tone of someone saying something final and true. Slight pause before 'truly'. Steady, direct eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: これからも、よろしく、お願いします。
lines.en: I'll continue to work hard. Please guide me as we move forward.
lines.style: Respectful promise with gentle urgency. Formal register, but warm underneath. The commitment of someone who means it. Slight bow in the voice. Soft, reaching — asking for continuance, not release.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Stay well — I'll come back again.
lines.style: Closing with quiet strength. Warm and sure. The promise of return, not farewell. Slight lift on 'again' — this isn't an ending. Composed, but the affection is unmissable. Final beat: steady, grounded.
